content.comment_body: Hello, I attempted to download and install [product_name] [version_no] but it does not install successfully. The installer runs but then disappears without any error messages. I even tried a second laptop with no success. I installed Java on my PC but still couldn't get the [product_name] software to install. I obtained the zip file from the [company_name] website. Where can I find a working version of [version_no] or an earlier release?

A complete version of [product_name] [version_no] is not available for download. Only an upgrade for users with an existing older installation is offered. If you do not already have a full installation or media, you will need to purchase it first.

Hello, I am experiencing the same issue. I have an original [product_name] [version_no] installed, but when I run the [version_no] installer, it proceeds to the EULA and then the setup closes without any warnings.
Please consider starting a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: Multiple users encounter issues installing [product_name] [version_no], with the installer closing without any error messages or explanations. Users are unaware that only upgrade installations are available and that a complete version must be acquired separately. The absence of clear instructions and communication during installation results in confusion and failed attempts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy installation process for [product_name] [version_no], and access to prior versions if needed. Clear guidance on upgrade requirements and installation procedures is anticipated.
